news.title: Surging bond yields wreak havoc on Dalal Street, but IMF sees more pain ahead. Why AI is one of the culprits
news.summary: The IMF has flagged three risks to global financial stability: an AI-driven market correction, rising sovereign bond yields and cyberattacks. These threats could trigger broader financial stress, while high borrowing and tight market linkages may amplify their economic impact.

news.title: RIL target price ahead of Jio IPO: 47% upside - Why Religare recommends buying Mukesh Ambani stock before issue launch
news.summary: Religare Broking recommends buying Reliance Industries, setting a target price of ₹1,696 against a reference price of ₹1,156, implying 46.7% upside. It sees a potential Jio Platforms IPO, improving cash flows, debt reduction and growth in Retail, O2C and New Energy as catalysts for a re-rating.
